props: Create a production pixel-art sprite atlas for CINDER SHIFT 64, a refined retro 2D side-view platform game. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Portrait canvas 1024x1536. EXACTLY 6 EQUAL COLUMNS x 10 EQUAL ROWS, 60 isolated object sprites, one sprite centered per cell; no text, no labels, no borders, no shadow outside each sprite, empty transparent margins at least 16 pixels around every sprite, no touching adjacent cells. Hard pixel edges, carefully authored 16-bit pixel art at about 80x80 logical pixels per object, material texture, dark navy outline, warm edge highlights, coherent lighting upper-left, readable silhouettes, side elevation with slight visible top thickness, NOT isometric. Palette dark ink #142331, blue gray #405c70, pale cream #efd6a4, brass #dfa568, rust #9b6456, mint #91d2b8, teal #65a7a5. Objects must be finished textured illustrations, not flat rectangles. Row1 kitchen: ceramic mug with handle; plate drying rack; wooden drawer with brass pull; bread bin; robot vacuum dock; copper kettle. Row2 desktop: mechanical keyboard; coiled electric cable; printer with paper tray; stacked books and pencils; articulated desk lamp; small desk fan. Row3 laundry: woven laundry basket; draped folded fabric; clothesline with clothespins; buckled fabric strap; ventilation duct; circular air damper. Row4 balcony: terracotta plant pot; broad green leaves; hanging striped towel; wind flag; rain gutter with water; metal weathervane. Row5 router shelf: wooden shelf and books; cable clips and cable; wireless router shell; brass conductor bridge; miniature beacon lighthouse; small phase installation with three sockets. Row6 fictional Adriatic city 1986: residential balcony with curtains; outdoor stair landing; analog telephone switch cabinet; rotary desk telephone; rooftop antenna; laundry hanging on rope. Row7 harbor: warehouse sliding gate; corrugated cargo container; dock crane; mooring bollard; industrial dock lamp; analog port transmitter. Row8 rail: station bench with platform canopy; paper timetable board with abstract tiny marks NO readable letters; electric commuter train front; train service door; tunnel masonry niche; traction power cabinet. Row9 factory: old lathe drive machine; conveyor assembly; steel catwalk section; analog power distributor; protective metal screen; flywheel and pipes. Row10 radio hill: coastal hill and stone steps; technical gallery rack; relay cabinet; antenna dish assembly; CRT equipment rack; contained violet dimensional rift. Every cell occupied by exactly one listed object in this exact reading order. Keep the normal world warm and humane, machinery detailed and worn, anomaly only violet. Overall commercial-quality game sprite sheet, cohesive shape language.

enemies: A production pixel-art ENEMY SPRITE SHEET for CINDER SHIFT 64 side-scrolling platform game. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Portrait 1024x1536, EXACTLY 5 EQUAL COLUMNS x 6 EQUAL ROWS, 30 isolated sprites centered in cells with generous empty margins. No text/labels/numbers/grid lines. Hard-edged 16-bit pixel art, carefully shaded metal textures and dark navy outline, consistent scale each row, facing LEFT, camera side view not isometric. Five columns are states: 1 idle/patrol; 2 warning with physically raised antenna/aperture and amber tell; 3 attack with muzzle discharge or deployed weapon; 4 recovery with armor OPEN showing vulnerable mint core; 5 destroyed broken wreck. State silhouettes must differ, not just recoloring. Row2 LINT ROTOR: hovering household fan drone, two small fabric-like impellers, turquoise spool body and brass lint cage, detachable casing opens to reveal core. Row3 LIDAR GUARDIAN: squat robot vacuum sentry on round base, cream and copper segmented shell, raised scan mast, clamshell armor opens in recovery. Row4 RELAY CRAWLER: anomalous 1986 analog telephone exchange robot, four short crab cable legs, olive steel chassis with rotary-relay coils, paper-tape slot, violet cabling. Row5 INDUCTION ORB: hovering segmented circular ceramic electrical insulator and copper coils, small analog meter eye, violet induction forks, fully open coil core in recovery. Row6 SIGNAL WATCHER: grounded analog radio transmitter turret on tripod with CRT eye and aerial, worn naval blue metal, amber tuning dial and violet anomalies, deployed dish for firing and open CRT cabinet for vulnerable recovery. All nonhuman mechanical adversaries, no human/animal enemies. Palette #142331 dark ink, #405c70 steel, #efd6a4 cream, #dfa568 brass, #65a7a5 teal, #91d2b8 vulnerable core, #8d809d violet, #9b6456 copper.
